cohort: The study included all women aged 15-49 years in Finland who experienced a pelvic or hip fracture leading to hospitalization between 1998-2018, along with a control group of women with wrist fractures.
finding: Women with pelvic fractures consistently had higher odds for Cesarean section across all time periods (up to 14 years post-fracture), while women with hip fractures had notably higher odds for CS, particularly within the first 5 years after the fracture.
mod_finding: Unplanned Cesarean section was more common after hip fractures in the initial period, though the exact reasons remain unclear.
